scenes.title: Arrival hall: cautious first exchange

camera.description: Locked eye-level 50mm view across the arrival hall, widescreen composition, symmetrical architectural depth, and a quiet central gap.

scenes.background_prompt: An empty worn underground stone arrival hall beneath a severe carved idol, broad cracked flagstones, a pale glowing arched gate centered deep in frame, low warm side lamps against cool gate light, restrained rubble near the outer walls, and calm uncluttered space across the lower frame.

subjects.identity_prompt: Maret is a stout, round-shouldered woman in her late sixties or early seventies with a broad soft face, deep-set gray eyes, loosened white hair, a flour-dusted rough gray dress, coarse apron, flat worn shoes, and a small plain utility knife secured at her waist.
subjects.pose_prompt: Three-quarter body at rest, shoulders slightly drawn in, hands relaxed near the apron, utility knife secured and untouched, neutral attentive expression.

variants.expression_prompt: quiet concern: brows drawn slightly together, lips pressed with uncertainty, eyes fixed on Edric
variants.pose_adjustment_prompt: tighten the shoulders a little and draw one hand protectively toward the apron; keep the other hand and the secured knife unchanged

subjects.identity_prompt: Edric is a broad-shouldered heavyset farmhand in his mid-forties with a weathered square face, short gray-brown hair, calloused hands, rough work shirt, patched canvas trousers, cracked boots, and a nicked woodcutter's axe resting head-down beside him.
subjects.pose_prompt: Three-quarter body in a guarded but conversational stance, axe resting head-down close beside the outer leg, both hands calm, neutral watchful expression.

variants.expression_prompt: a restrained reassuring look: brow eased, mouth softened without a broad smile, attention on Maret
variants.pose_adjustment_prompt: lift only the inner hand into a small open-palm reassuring gesture while the outer hand keeps the axe planted and unchanged

scenes.title: Scout briefing: disagreement at the map table

camera.description: Locked eye-level 55mm view across a compact stone planning room, widescreen composition, shallow architectural depth, and a clear central opening.

scenes.background_prompt: An empty compact stone planning room with a broad scarred map table set low in the rear middle distance, amber lantern niches, a narrow rain-dark window, pinned parchment shapes without legible writing, muted green cloth accents, and uncluttered floor across the foreground.

subjects.identity_prompt: Rowan is a lean olive-complexioned man in his late twenties with tousled ash-blond hair, green eyes, a cropped charcoal scout jacket, forest-green scarf, map case, and two visibly mismatched short knives kept sheathed.
subjects.pose_prompt: Three-quarter body in a relaxed briefing stance, hands clear of the sheathed knives, head slightly inclined toward Renna, neutral analytical expression.

variants.expression_prompt: measured skepticism: one brow slightly raised, eyes narrowed in thought, mouth held in a thin doubtful line
variants.pose_adjustment_prompt: tilt the head a few degrees and fold only the inner forearm loosely across the torso; keep the scarf, map case, and sheathed knives fixed

subjects.identity_prompt: Renna is a slim athletic woman in her mid-twenties with sun-warm skin, copper-red shoulder-length hair, gray starter tunic, patched boots, a cheap ash shortbow, low quiver, and one long brown bracer; the bow remains lowered at her outer side.
subjects.pose_prompt: Three-quarter body standing squarely but at ease, lowered bow at the outer side, inner hand relaxed, head turned slightly toward Rowan, neutral focused expression.

variants.expression_prompt: quiet determination: chin set, eyes steady, brows level and focused without anger
variants.pose_adjustment_prompt: straighten the posture slightly and close the inner hand into a loose restrained fist; keep the lowered bow and quiver unchanged

scenes.title: Holdout: champions before the gate

camera.description: Locked eye-level 60mm view across a formal gate anteroom, widescreen composition, shallow depth, restrained symmetry, and a clear central opening.

scenes.background_prompt: An empty formal gate anteroom of pale limestone and ash-black iron, tall ribbed door in the rear, narrow cobalt banners, cool joint lights, one warm ceiling shaft, subdued floor reflections, and uncluttered lower corners.

subjects.identity_prompt: Halcyon is a tall bronze-complexioned man in his mid-thirties with white-gold bound hair, topaz eyes, pearl-white articulated armor, cobalt silk, split ivory mantle, and a pale-gold banner-lance held upright at his outer side.
subjects.pose_prompt: Three-quarter body in a composed formal stance, banner-lance vertical at the outer side, inner hand relaxed, head turned slightly toward Mirelle, neutral disciplined expression.

variants.expression_prompt: restrained private amusement: a slight one-corner smile and warmer eyes without losing composure
variants.pose_adjustment_prompt: relax the inner shoulder and open the inner hand slightly; keep armor, mantle, and upright banner-lance fixed

subjects.identity_prompt: Mirelle is a tall athletic woman in her late twenties with sun-warm skin, copper-red high braided ponytail, an ivory-and-crimson fighting coat, oxblood guards, bright steel shoulders, and a complete leaf-bladed ash spear held upright at her outer side.
subjects.pose_prompt: Three-quarter body in an alert formal stance, spear vertical at the outer side, inner hand at rest, head turned slightly toward Halcyon, neutral assessing expression.

variants.expression_prompt: dry unimpressed patience: one brow faintly raised and lips held almost flat
variants.pose_adjustment_prompt: shift the weight subtly to the outer hip and rest the inner hand lightly at the waist; keep the spear and all armor fixed
